screens.description: Skippable animated prologue detailing the arrival of El Niño weather front over Oman, introducing Ruqayya School & Ambassador character.
Modal for entering student name and grade class, issuing the official Safety Passport.
Interactive school map showing 8 levels with status (completed/active/locked), star ratings, passport launcher, and settings.
Main gameplay shell hosting high-res background, HUD bar, character dialogue box, and active interactive challenge.
2-Page leather passport displaying 8 collected Omani ink stamps, student details, achievements, and statistics.
Audio volume controls (Master, Music, SFX, Narrator) and RTL display options.
Final victory summary with overall score, total stars, passport verification, learning takeaways, and certificate trigger.
Printable A4 landscape certificate with gold borders, school seal, stamp, student name, class, and print/download PDF functionality.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows RTL direction by using dir='rtl' on top-level elements.
Import Noto Kufi Arabic, Noto Sans Arabic, and Amiri Google Fonts into index.html or index.css.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, input fields, interactive options, sound toggles, and navigation nodes.
Ensure sound effects work seamlessly with Web Audio API or audio elements, fallback gracefully if autoplay policy blocks audio.
Implement the Printable Certificate with dedicated @media print CSS rules so that printing hides header/footer UI elements and formats clean A4 landscape output.
Maintain state in local storage so students do not lose their passport stamps or progress upon refreshing.
Validate student registration name and class grade before initiating game map.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.rtl_requirement: All typography, margins, paddings, and flex directions must adapt to RTL.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_requirement: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 text contrast using amber/white text on dark navy translucent surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: Every clickable element (level node, choice button, volume slider, passport toggle) MUST include data-testid.
